ingredients.name: water-packed tuna, 6 ounces, drained and flaked

steps.instruction: Put 1 can (6 ounces) of drained, flaked tuna in a small bowl.
Add 1/4 cup of finely chopped celery and 1/4 cup of finely chopped onion.
Spread the tuna mixture on the bottoms of 4 split hamburger buns.
Top each with a mozzarella cheese slice and a tomato slice.
Place the buns on an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake for 12 minutes, until heated through and the cheese melts.
steps.spoken: Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the sandwiches are heated through and the cheese has melted.

steps.instruction: Top each with a lettuce leaf and replace the bun tops.
